Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Clouse
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 231 as introduced makes a supplemental appropriation of federal funds from the Alabama Emergency Rental Assistance Fund to the Department of Finance in the estimated amount of $263,236,067 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2021. These funds will be delegated by memorandum of agreement to the Alabama Housing Finance Authority to administer the Emergency Rental Assistance Program, and any amount that remains unexpended on September 30, 2021 will be reappropriated to the Department for the same purpose for the fiscal year beginning October 1, 2021.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Clouse
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 231 as passed the House of Representatives makes a supplemental appropriation of federal funds from the Alabama Emergency Rental Assistance Fund to the Department of Finance in the estimated amount of $263,236,067 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2021. These funds will be delegated by memorandum of agreement to the Alabama Housing Finance Authority to administer the Emergency Rental Assistance Program, and any amount that remains unexpended on September 30, 2021 will be reappropriated to the Department for the same purpose for the fiscal year beginning October 1, 2021.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Faulkner
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 344 as introduced would provide (1) that persons who qualify for certain homestead exemptions may initially claim the exemption by mail, or electronically at the discretion of the tax assessing official; and (2) that persons required to verify eligibility of the exemption annually may do so electronically at the discretion of the tax assessing official. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue by an undetermined amount to assist tax assessors in developing recommendations to reduce fraud where homestead exemptions are claimed. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
